transcript.text: Core market = region 'North' per saved definition. Now count orders by customers in that region.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'North'

transcript.text:
